chapters.summary_hi: Computer ek electronic device hai jo raw data ko input lekar process karta hai aur meaningful output deta hai. Father of Computer: Charles Babbage.
chapters.summary_en: A computer is an electronic device that accepts raw data as input, processes it according to instructions, and produces meaningful output.

points.b_hi: 1st: Vacuum Tubes (ENIAC) | 2nd: Transistors | 3rd: Integrated Circuits (IC - Jack Kilby) | 4th: Microprocessor (Intel 4004) | 5th: AI & ULSI
points.b_en: 1st: Vacuum Tubes | 2nd: Transistors | 3rd: Integrated Circuits (IC) | 4th: Microprocessor | 5th: AI & ULSI

points.b_hi: Register > Cache > RAM (Volatile) > ROM (Non-Volatile) > SSD/HDD. 1 Byte = 8 Bits, 1 Nibble = 4 Bits, 1 KB = 1024 Bytes.
points.b_en: Register > Cache > RAM (Volatile) > ROM (Non-Volatile) > Secondary Storage. 1 Byte = 8 Bits, 1 Nibble = 4 Bits.

points.b_hi: Input: Keyboard, Mouse, OCR, OMR, MICR, Barcode Reader, Joystick. Output: Monitor, Printer (Impact: Dot Matrix; Non-Impact: Laser, Inkjet), Plotter.
points.b_en: Input: Keyboard, Mouse, OCR, OMR, MICR, Scanner. Output: Monitor, Laser/Inkjet Printer, Plotter.

chapters.trap_hi: Exam Trap: Plotter ek Output device hai (CAD/Engineering drawings ke liye), Scanner nahi!
chapters.trap_en: Exam Trap: Plotter is an Output device used for vector graphics, not an Input device.

chapters.summary_hi: Operating System user aur hardware ke beech interface ka kaam karta hai. Examples: Windows, Linux (Ubuntu), macOS, Android.
chapters.summary_en: An Operating System acts as an intermediary between computer hardware and the user.

points.b_hi: Linux ek Open-Source OS hai (Linus Torvalds, 1991). Ubuntu Linux ka popular distro hai. Root user superuser hota hai.
points.b_en: Linux is an open-source kernel created by Linus Torvalds in 1991. Ubuntu is a popular Debian-based distribution.

points.b_hi: ls (list files), pwd (print working directory), mkdir (create folder), rm (remove file), chmod (change file permissions), cp (copy).
points.b_en: ls (list directory), pwd (current path), mkdir (make directory), rm (delete), chmod (permissions), mv (move/rename).

points.b_hi: Shift + Delete se file Recycle Bin mein gaye bina permanently delete hoti hai. Task Manager shortcut: Ctrl + Shift + Esc.
points.b_en: Shift + Delete permanently deletes files bypassing Recycle Bin. Ctrl + Shift + Esc opens Task Manager.

chapters.trap_hi: Exam Trap: Ubuntu mein default web browser Firefox hota hai aur default office suite LibreOffice hota hai.
chapters.trap_en: Exam Trap: Firefox is the default browser and LibreOffice is the default office suite in Ubuntu.

chapters.summary_hi: NIELIT CCC syllabus mein MS Word ki jagah LibreOffice Writer se sawal aate hain. Default file extension: .odt
chapters.summary_en: LibreOffice Writer is the open-source word processor tested in NIELIT CCC. Default extension: .odt.

points.b_hi: Writer mein Minimum Zoom 20% aur Maximum Zoom 600% hota hai. Default Font: Liberation Serif (12 pt).
points.b_en: Minimum Zoom in Writer is 20% and Maximum Zoom is 600%. Default font is Liberation Serif (12 pt).

points.b_hi: Ctrl+H (Find & Replace), Ctrl+Shift+P (Superscript), Ctrl+Shift+B (Subscript), F7 (Spelling), Ctrl+F12 (Insert Table), Ctrl+Enter (Page Break).
points.b_en: Ctrl+H (Find & Replace), Ctrl+Shift+P (Superscript), Ctrl+Shift+B (Subscript), F7 (Spellcheck), Ctrl+F12 (Insert Table).

points.b_hi: Mail Merge wizard Tools menu mein hota hai. Direct Export as PDF option File menu mein milta hai.
points.b_en: Mail Merge wizard is found under the Tools menu. Direct Export as PDF is under the File menu.

chapters.trap_hi: Exam Trap: MS Word mein Superscript Ctrl+Shift++ hota hai, lekin LibreOffice Writer mein Ctrl+Shift+P hota hai!
chapters.trap_en: Exam Trap: Superscript in LibreOffice Writer is Ctrl+Shift+P (not Ctrl+Shift++).

chapters.summary_hi: Data analysis, formulas aur charts ke liye LibreOffice Calc use hota hai. Default file extension: .ods
chapters.summary_en: LibreOffice Calc is used for numerical data, formulas, and charts. Default extension: .ods.

points.b_hi: Total Rows: 1,048,576 | Total Columns: 1,024 (Last column: AMJ) | Zoom: Min 20%, Max 400%.
points.b_en: Total Rows: 1,048,576 | Total Columns: 1,024 (Last column: AMJ) | Zoom: Min 20%, Max 400%.

points.b_hi: Har formula '=' se start hota hai. =SUM(A1:A5), =AVERAGE(), =COUNT(), =MAX(), =MIN(), =ROUND(123.456, 2) -> 123.46, =MOD(10,3) -> 1.
points.b_en: Formulas start with '='. =ROUND(123.456, 2) returns 123.46; =MOD(10,3) returns 1; =QUOTIENT(10,3) returns 3.

points.b_hi: Ctrl+; (Current Date), Ctrl+Shift+; (Current Time), F2 (Edit Cell), Ctrl+1 (Format Cells), Ctrl+` (Show Formulas).
points.b_en: Ctrl+; (Insert Date), Ctrl+Shift+; (Insert Time), F2 (Edit Cell), Ctrl+1 (Format Cells).

chapters.trap_hi: Exam Trap: Calc mein cell ke andar new line dalne ke liye Ctrl + Enter dabate hain (Excel mein Alt+Enter hota hai).
chapters.trap_en: Exam Trap: Use Ctrl + Enter to insert a line break inside a Calc cell.

chapters.summary_hi: Slideshow aur visual presentations banane ke liye LibreOffice Impress use hota hai. Default extension: .odp
chapters.summary_en: LibreOffice Impress is used to create slide presentations. Default extension: .odp.

points.b_hi: Impress mein Minimum Zoom 5% aur Maximum Zoom 3000% hota hai. Views: Normal, Outline, Notes, Slide Sorter, Master Slide.
points.b_en: Minimum Zoom in Impress is 5% and Maximum Zoom is 3000%. Views include Normal, Outline, Notes, and Slide Sorter.

points.b_hi: F5 (Start Slide Show from 1st slide), Shift+F5 (Start from Current Slide), Ctrl+M (Insert New Slide), Esc (End Slide Show).
points.b_en: F5 (Start Slide Show), Shift+F5 (From Current Slide), Ctrl+M (New Slide), Esc (Exit Slide Show).

chapters.trap_hi: Exam Trap: Impress mein New Slide insert karne ka shortcut Ctrl + M hota hai (Ctrl + N se naya presentation khulta hai).
chapters.trap_en: Exam Trap: Ctrl + M inserts a new slide, whereas Ctrl + N creates a new presentation.

chapters.summary_hi: Internet networks ka network hai. WWW (World Wide Web) ke inventor Tim Berners-Lee hain (1989).
chapters.summary_en: The Internet is a global network of networks. Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989.

points.b_hi: IPv4: 32-bit (4 octets, 0-255, e.g., 192.168.1.1) | IPv6: 128-bit (Hexadecimal) | MAC Address: 48-bit physical address.
points.b_en: IPv4 is 32-bit (0-255 per octet), IPv6 is 128-bit hexadecimal, and MAC address is a 48-bit hardware address.

points.b_hi: HTTP (Port 80), HTTPS (Port 443), FTP (Port 21), SMTP (Port 25 - Email bhejne ke liye), POP3 (Port 110) & IMAP (Port 143 - Email receive karne ke liye).
points.b_en: HTTP (80), HTTPS (443), FTP (21), SMTP (25 for sending mail), POP3 (110) & IMAP (143 for receiving mail).

points.b_hi: OSI Model mein 7 layers hoti hain (Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application). Star topology mein central Hub/Switch hota hai.
points.b_en: OSI Model has 7 layers. Star topology connects all nodes to a central Hub or Switch.

chapters.trap_hi: Exam Trap: First Search Engine 'Archie' tha aur First Web Browser 'WorldWideWeb' (baad mein Nexus) tha.
chapters.trap_en: Exam Trap: Archie was the first search engine, and WorldWideWeb (later Nexus) was the first web browser.

chapters.summary_hi: Electronic mail (Ray Tomlinson, 1971) aur government digital services jaise UMANG, DigiLocker, IRCTC.
chapters.summary_en: Electronic mail (invented by Ray Tomlinson in 1971) and digital public services like UMANG and DigiLocker.

points.b_hi: CC (Carbon Copy): Sabhi recipients ko ek dusre ka email dikhta hai. BCC (Blind Carbon Copy): Recipients ek dusre ka address nahi dekh sakte.
points.b_en: CC makes all recipients visible to each other; BCC hides recipient email addresses from one another.

points.b_hi: UMANG: Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance (13+ languages). DigiLocker: Cloud storage for official documents (1 GB free space).
points.b_en: UMANG stands for Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance. DigiLocker stores verified digital certificates.

points.b_hi: Twitter (X) standard post limit: 280 characters. Telegram aur WhatsApp instant messaging apps hain.
points.b_en: Standard X (Twitter) character limit is 280 characters.

chapters.trap_hi: Exam Trap: Email address mein '@' symbol hona compulsory hai aur spaces allowed nahi hote.
chapters.trap_en: Exam Trap: An email address must contain '@' and cannot contain blank spaces.

chapters.title_hi: डिजिटल वित्तीय उपकरण (UPI, AEPS, NEFT, RTGS)
chapters.summary_hi: Cashless banking systems jo NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) aur RBI dwara operate kiye jate hain.
chapters.summary_en: Digital payment ecosystems operated by NPCI and RBI.

points.b_hi: UPI (Unified Payments Interface) NPCI ne launch kiya. Bina internet ke mobile banking ke liye *99# (USSD) dial karte hain.
points.b_en: UPI is developed by NPCI. Dial *99# for offline USSD-based mobile banking.

points.b_hi: NEFT: No minimum limit, 24x7 batches. RTGS: Minimum ₹2 Lakh, real-time gross settlement. IMPS: 24x7 instant transfer.
points.b_en: NEFT has no minimum limit; RTGS has a ₹2 Lakh minimum limit; IMPS provides 24x7 instant interbank transfer.

points.b_hi: AEPS: Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (Biometric + Aadhaar number). CVV: Card Verification Value (Visa/Mastercard mein 3 digits, Amex mein 4 digits).
points.b_en: AEPS uses Aadhaar & biometrics. CVV is 3 digits on Visa/Mastercard/RuPay and 4 digits on American Express.

chapters.trap_hi: Exam Trap: RTGS mein minimum transfer limit ₹2,00,000 (2 Lakh) hoti hai, koi maximum cap nahi hai.
chapters.trap_en: Exam Trap: RTGS requires a minimum transaction of ₹2 Lakh.

chapters.title_hi: फ्यूचर स्किल्स और साइबर सुरक्षा (IoT, AI, Blockchain)
chapters.summary_hi: Emerging technologies (IoT, Big Data, Cloud, AI, RPA, 3D Printing) aur cyber attacks se bachav.
chapters.summary_en: Emerging Industry 4.0 technologies and cyber security best practices.

points.b_hi: IoT (Internet of Things - Kevin Ashton), AI (John McCarthy), Cloud Computing (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), Blockchain (Crypto ledger), RPA (Robotic Process Automation).
points.b_en: IoT (coined by Kevin Ashton), AI (John McCarthy), Cloud Models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Blockchain, and RPA.

points.b_hi: Phishing: Fake emails/links se password churana. Ransomware: Files encrypt karke firoti mangna. Firewall: Unauthorized network traffic block karta hai.
points.b_en: Phishing steals credentials via fake links; Ransomware locks files for ransom; Firewalls filter unauthorized traffic.

chapters.trap_hi: Exam Trap: OTP (One-Time Password) aur 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication) account security badhate hain; OTP kisi ke saath share nahi karna chahiye.
chapters.trap_en: Exam Trap: OTP stands for One-Time Password and provides dynamic two-factor authentication.
